preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly n integers p_i and n characters (A or B) in assignment, where n is the first line.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in p)
preconditions.description: Each piece strength p_i is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'A', 'B'} for c in assignment)
preconditions.description: Each character in assignment is either 'A' or 'B'.
The number of pieces n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max(sum(p[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i] == 'B'), sum(p[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i] == 'A') - sum(p[i] for i in range(k) if assignment[i] == 'A') + sum(p[i] for i in range(k) if assignment[i] == 'B'), sum(p[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i] == 'B') - sum(p[i] for i in range(n - k) if assignment[i] == 'B') + sum(p[i] for i in range(n - k) if assignment[i] == 'A') for k in range(1, n + 1))) if n > 0 else '0'
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum strength Bob can achieve by either doing nothing (original assignment) or flipping a prefix or suffix of length k (1 ≤ k ≤ n) in the assignment string, where the strength is the sum of p_i for all pieces assigned to Bob ('B') after the flip.
